header: Four people who open the data portal before they open anything else
lead: The series is public, which means the institute is rarely the first to notice what it shows. These are the readers who told us what they do with it.

quotes.quote_text: We used to wait for the annual report to find out what the river had done. Now we read the same numbers on the same afternoon and plan the discharge around them.
quotes.author: Peter Sonnleitner

image.alternative: A woman in her late twenties

quotes.quote_text: My sixth years pull the July series themselves and argue about the outliers. That argument is the lesson — I could never have staged it with a textbook table.
quotes.author: Miriam Kaltner

quotes.quote_text: Before a permit hearing I check the two stations either side of the outfall. It takes four minutes and it has changed what we ask for twice now.
quotes.author: Andrej Lubic

quotes.quote_text: The raw series is why we trust the cleaned one. Being shown what was discarded is worth more than being told the result is reliable.
quotes.author: Dr. Feline Oberkirch
quotes.role: Hydrology group, Talhof university of applied sciences
